{{Top}}
'''Theed Quoits''' was a game played on water with a [[quoit]] where the objective was to throw the quoit into small poles for points. It was a pursuit that taught patience and concentration, as well as providing gentle exercise. It was said to have been once played with carnivorous [[Fish/Legends|fish]] in the water and began life as a hunting technique on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] was known to play.
